nodes.label: Select Receipt Image Picker
nodes.rationale: Bordered area with camera-icon button to attach a receipt photo to the transaction.

nodes.label: Home Screen Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Dark-themed home view: greeting header with search button, stacked wallet card carousel showing balance/income/expense, recent transactions list, lime floating add button, and custom 4-item bottom navigation bar.

nodes.label: Custom Bottom Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: Four tabs (Home, Statistics, Wallets, Profile) with the active tab highlighted in lime green accent.

nodes.label: Transaction Item Row
nodes.rationale: Each row has a colored category icon (Health red heart, Savings green bank, Clothing purple shirt, Others arrow), description, signed amount colored green for income / red for expense, and date.

nodes.label: Stacked Wallet Card Carousel
nodes.rationale: Wallets (Travel, Savings, ...) shown as a stack of cards; each card shows wallet name, balance, income (green) and expense (red) to give an at-a-glance summary per wallet.

nodes.label: Add New Transaction Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Modal sheet over home screen with back button and form to create a transaction.

nodes.label: Add New Transaction Form
nodes.rationale: Fields: Transaction Type dropdown, Wallet dropdown, Transaction Category dropdown, day/month/year date picker, amount (0.00), multi-line description, receipt image picker.

nodes.label: Statistics Screen Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Statistics tab active in bottom nav; period toggle, income vs expense bar chart, and transactions list below.

nodes.label: Income vs Expense Weekly Bar Chart
nodes.norm_label: income vs expense weekly bar chart
nodes.rationale: Grouped bars per weekday (Mn-Su), lime = income, red = expense, y-axis 0-3K; Saturday shows peak income near 3K, Sunday ~2K income, expenses small across the week.

nodes.label: Dark Theme with Lime Accent
nodes.rationale: Consistent visual language across screens: near-black backgrounds, lime-green primary accent, green for income and red for expense.
